texto.es: Nos cuentas el problema y coordinamos el horario que te funcione.
texto.en: Tell us the problem and we schedule a time that works for you.

texto.es: Revisamos la fuga, el destape o la instalación y te explicamos la solución.
texto.en: We check the leak, the clog or the install and explain the fix.

texto.es: Hacemos el trabajo con las herramientas adecuadas, sin dejar sorpresas despues.
texto.en: We do the work with the right tools, no surprises afterward.

texto.es: Probamos que todo funcione antes de irnos y dejamos el área limpia.
texto.en: We test that everything works before leaving and clean up the area.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza según el problema. Llama y Bruz te da el precio antes de empezar.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the problem. Call and Bruz will give you the price before starting.

texto.es: Destapamos y probamos el drenaje para confirmar que el problema quedó resuelto.
texto.en: We snake and test the drain to confirm the problem is actually resolved.

texto.es: Reparamos fugas en tuberías, llaves y conexiones visibles o escondidas.
texto.en: We repair leaks in pipes, faucets and connections, visible or hidden.

texto.es: Instalación y reemplazo de inodoros, tinas, duchas y lavamanos.
texto.en: Installation and replacement of toilets, tubs, showers and sinks.

texto.es: Conexión de lavadoras y líneas de agua exteriores sin dejar filtraciones.
texto.en: Washer hookups and exterior water lines, without leaving leaks behind.

pie.es: Servicio el mismo día cuando la agenda lo permite. Pregunta al llamar.
pie.en: Same-day service when the schedule allows. Ask when you call.

items.quote: Mr. Bruz delivers great service and he is very reliable. So far Mr. Bruz has been my plumber for 3 years and he has not let me down yet. I highly recommend his services to anyone needing an effective and efficient plumbing company.
Bruz is very thorough and detailed. Today my sink was clogged and he snaked it and tested it to make sure it was good before he left.
Bruzz provided a professional service and was very organized; he resolved the issue and cleaned up after the work was completed.
